text: Continuous integration, or CI, is a common practice in modern software development. When developers add new code to a shared project, automated builds start immediately. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become serious problems. CI pipelines make this process fast and reliable, so developers can fix mistakes quickly and keep the project stable. As a result, teams can deliver better software more often and with less stress.
